headline: Berlin Linke/Greens/SPD Vorgespräch: no deal yet, maybe weekend round 2; Pistorius announces Drohnenregiment (≤600, 2027); RKI: first locally acquired Sindbis case in DE; Gemini Guided Vision on Android.

stories.title: Berlin: first Dreier-Vorgespräch — no deal yet
facts: Linke (25.7% winner), Greens and SPD held the first three-way Vorgespräch on antisemitism / racism / organised crime at Haus der Statistik near Alexanderplatz (dpa-AFX ~17:53).
No joint line announced; chairs Kerstin Wolter (Linke), Nina Stahr (Greens), Bettina König (SPD) called the exchange “constructive” and agreed confidentiality.
Parties say they will talk again — not Friday; weekend (possibly Saturday) floated unofficially; Sondierungen could follow next week if Vorgespräche clear.
Context: Neukölln election-party / clan-contact debate and Ferat Koçak quitting the Bundestag Innenausschuss still frame the trust hurdle before formal sondings.
stories.whyItMatters: Material update on this afternoon’s lead: the first Dreierformat happened and did not unlock Sondierungen yet — the antisemitism/clan gate remains the path dependency for a red-green-red Berlin executive.

stories.title: Pistorius: first Bundeswehr Drohnenregiment in 2027
facts: At Truppenübungsplatz Bergen, Defence Minister Boris Pistorius said the Heer will stand up a standalone unmanned-systems regiment during 2027.
Up to ~600 personnel; ranges from close-in to ~500 km; includes unmanned air and ground systems plus an organic electromagnetic-warfare company.
Loitering munition (“Kamikaze”) drones already in trials are slated to reach troops next year and equip the new regiment.
Quote: “Wer sich zu Land durchsetzen will, der muss eben den Kampf mit unbemannten Systemen beherrschen.”
stories.whyItMatters: First named Drohnenregiment packages Ukraine-war lessons into a permanent Heer formation — tempo and EW, not just airframes.

stories.title: RKI: first locally acquired Sindbis fever case in Germany
facts: RKI reports the first confirmed human Sindbis-virus (SINV) illness acquired in Germany: a 60-year-old man in Baden-Württemberg.
Onset 12 Jul; doctors first tested for Chikungunya (Asian tiger mosquito area), then expanded to SINV — lab confirmation in September.
Prior clues: SINV in mosquitoes near Weinheim and antibodies in local blood donors years ago; bird–mosquito cycle; no known human-to-human spread.
Symptoms: sudden fever, itchy rash, marked joint pain (Chikungunya-like); not considered life-threatening; no specific antiviral — supportive care / mosquito protection.
stories.whyItMatters: Confirms that where SINV already circulates in mosquitoes/birds, clinical human cases are possible — a diagnostic nudge for mosquito season, not a pandemic alarm.

image.alt: Mosquito close-up illustrating vector-borne infection risk

stories.title: Google: Guided Vision in Gemini Live for Android
facts: Google launches Guided Vision in Gemini Live on compatible Android 9+ devices where Gemini Live is supported.
Camera share → real-time spoken scene descriptions, follow-ups, and verbal reframing cues (pan/tilt/step back) built with the blind and low-vision community.
Training/testing partnership with Aira (tens of thousands of hours of visual interpretation; 1,000+ Trusted Testers); access via Gemini app toggle, Android accessibility shortcut, or TalkBack menu.
Google caveat: assistive only — not a medical device, mobility aid, or navigation/obstacle tool.
stories.whyItMatters: A shipped, camera-first accessibility agent from Google — primary source is the company post, not a press rewrite.

stories.title: Reiche drafts tougher Investitionsprüfgesetz
facts: Handelsblatt reports an 86-page draft “Investitionsprüfgesetz” from Economy Minister Katherina Reiche (CDU) consolidating and tightening foreign-investment screening.
Ban thresholds easier; more sectors treated as critical; screening would also cover certain buyers from European partner countries for the first time.
China is not named, but critical deals are often Chinese-linked; Zippel logistics takeover by Cosco reportedly headed for a federal ban next week.
Draft is finished in BMWK this week but not yet inter-ministerially agreed; ministry spokesperson declined detail.
stories.whyItMatters: Moves Germany from scattered FDI rules toward a harder security screen — still a draft, not law.
